blocks.text: The form wants the digits on the plastic, the month and year, and the short code on the back.
It does not ask for the sign-in secret of your bank site.
The host in the header is the shop you opened. The tag on Wildflower honey jar, 12 oz matches the amount due.
No sleeve is ticked. No repeat parcel is marked.
Fragile glass leaves the stockroom in a double mailer.
You are paying Lumenfield at www.lumenfield.example.
